pr_body:
Add new settings and change crop_len behavior to count words instead of characters.

- [x] `highlightPreTag`
- [x] `highlightPostTag`
- [x] `cropMarker`
- [x] `cropLength` count word instead of chars
- [x] `cropLength` 0 is now considered as no `cropLength`
- [ ] ~smart crop finding the best matches interval~ (postponed)

Partially fixes  #2214. (no smart crop)

issue_context.body:
Here is the spec: https://github.com/meilisearch/specifications/pull/120

More information is coming once the spec is stabilized.

## Implementation
### Pull requests
- #2297
- [milli#483](https://github.com/meilisearch/milli/pull/483)

### checklist
- [x] `highlightPreTag` settings (#2297)
- [x] `highlightPostTag` settings (#2297)
- [x] `cropMarker` settings (#2297)
- [x] `cropLength` count word instead of chars (#2297)
- [x] `cropLength` 0 is now considered as no `cropLength` (#2297)
- [ ] ~smart crop finding the best matches interval~ (postponed) [milli#483](https://github.com/meilisearch/milli/pull/483)
comments: Pinging @meilisearch/integration-team and @meilisearch/docs-team. The spec is still a WIP, I will let you know when we'll have some updates.

@meilisearch/integration-team and @meilisearch/docs-team: the smart crop is officially delayed to v0.28.0. All the other planned features are present.

A new issue has been open to handle the smart crop planned in v0.28.0: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/issues/2299
So cropping will keep its current behaviour: find the first occurrence of a search term and crop X amount of words starting from there, correct?
Yes @guimachiavelli! :) the change of behavior will be for v0.28.0

review_comments:
crop 0 behavior changes, we are now considering that crop 0 is equivalent to no crop.
